gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-w: Chunky, raw lowercase leads the way in Capture Smallz. Noto Sans Wancho follows in a clean sans-serif, its e left open at the terminal, so the heavy heading gets room to bark.
Capture Smallz stomps in with raw, big-bodied lowercase and a tactical edge. Noto Sans Warang Citi settles beneath it, wide channels leading into each counter so words land as solid blocks.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-y: Noto Sans Yi sets down a deep-bellied lowercase whose rounds stay unlatched, like open hooks. Capture Smallz hits harder above it, raw and tactical, and the two never crowd each other.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-z: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square brings a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. And Capture Smallz, raw and big-bodied above it, gives that plain sans a heading with real muscle.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-tradit: Fat, raw lowercase gives Capture Smallz its tactical swagger, and it stands well apart from the text below. Noto Traditional Nushu flows easily, its broad-nibbed sans strokes never curling shut.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-numans: Capture Smallz hits with raw, big-bodied lowercase, while Numans answers in a modern sans whose s hangs its ends far from the spine. Its loose tracking is the real draw.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-onest: Raw, tactical, and stocky. Capture Smallz is heavy where Onest is a rope-thin plain sans with no thick or thin parts, short ascenders sitting over big bowls.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-open-sans: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, all big-bodied lowercase. Open Sans takes over below as a smooth plain sans with bulky proportions and no clogged curves, so the heavy heading has something friendly to hand off to.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-orienta: Raw, big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz a tactical punch that grabs attention fast. And Orienta, a modern sans-serif with breathing counters and little height difference between cases, does the quiet work of carrying the text.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-oxygen: Capture Smallz brings raw, tactical lowercase with a big body and plenty of attitude up top. But Oxygen keeps its curves open in a clean sans, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
